text: APPROVE. The split into `RuleReplaces`, `IsCandidateFor` and `DeclsReplace` preserves the original logic exactly (the negated `Key != … && !Universal` check becomes `Key == … || Universal`, and the `continue`/`return true` paths map one-to-one). `Replaced` itself is now a single loop with one condition, well under 15. I couldn't build it here, but the new helpers use all their parameters and take the same types the original passed to `Outranks`, so I see no new warnings.
